automated_checks.detail: Full inspected user-repository commit bound.
Two controls, two weight arms, four recovery arms; five map arms.
All new U/map IDs named in main instructions.
Same explicit exposed cohorts; no independent-confirmation claim.
20 development maps + at most8 transfer maps.
No required losing family transfer.
Historical complete baseline maps reused.
Endpoints use actual source-availability behavior.
U additions cannot steal existing painted support.
No GT-based candidate/view selection.
FC vs native tested on same actual request, with coverage disclosed.
Existing paid Q recovery is not misattributed to FC.
Absent captured views remain explicitly unrecovered.
Distinguishes current dense cache from older pooled-only caches.
Small recovery-only budget; snapshot prevents order-dependent budget expansion.
No imagined logits or unauthorized SAM rerun.
Protects full candidates rather than creating residual fragments.
Two past own-map snapshots; no final-map oracle.
Candidate/count/fresh-label/alias semantics specified.
Separates capacity relaxation from specificity/union constraints.
Missing semantic measurements not fabricated as zero.
New owners enter official masks and ranking context.
Freeze before transfer; all data still exposed.
Actual code/results/report push with external final receipt.
12 executed synthetic tests; not a production native or dataset validation.
Scoped checks only, not inherited giant audits.
Local links resolve; public source links pinned.

manual_design_review.issue: Previous simple gamma formula would change missing-source behavior
manual_design_review.resolution: Interpolate exact FC_EQ/D2 endpoints; missing sources fixed; synthetic test executed.

manual_design_review.issue: Old SAM cache does not contain logits
manual_design_review.resolution: Use per-track bit masks and recorded winning pixels; no second-best score reconstruction.

manual_design_review.issue: Native-ineligible owner can already have Q evidence
manual_design_review.resolution: Add UQ paid-query control before attributing gains to new FC.

manual_design_review.issue: Recovery eligibility was frozen intentionally in wave1
manual_design_review.resolution: Authorize a new append-only U identity; preserve old painted masks and official scoring.

manual_design_review.issue: Association fallback can still be broken by global alias tokens or fresh-group restrictions
manual_design_review.resolution: Per-group actions across C++ and hard tokens only on actually constrained labels; real native test assigned to Codex.

manual_design_review.issue: A strict one-to-one control cannot isolate group-coverage constraint
manual_design_review.resolution: A1 fallback, A2 free many-to-one, A3 specificity+union; three separate arms.

manual_design_review.issue: Geometry-first screen conflicts with old all-readouts-locked diagnose_map
manual_design_review.resolution: Task-local map-lock diagnostic stage and truthful unmeasured semantic status.

manual_design_review.issue: Adding candidates can change old ranks despite fixed old masks
manual_design_review.resolution: Recompute all official area ranks and report lost matches.

manual_design_review.issue: Past exhaustive schedule spent on an equivalent ratio gate
manual_design_review.resolution: No ratio arm, no forced map transfer, predeclared catastrophic fragmentation stop.

manual_design_review.issue: External cache/real data availability is unverified by this assistant
manual_design_review.resolution: Explicit bind stage; incomplete leaf status rather than manufactured coverage; no new benchmark claims.
